E03-SCH: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY name

E04-SCH: SELECT model FROM aircraft_types WHERE manufacturer = 'Airbus'
E04-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aircraft_types.model) FROM aircraft_types INNER JOIN aircraft_types.manufacturer ON aircraft_types.manufacturer_id = aircraft_types.manufacturer WHERE aircraft_types.manufacturer = 'Airbus'

E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'

E09-BIZ: SELECT SUM(capacity_tonnes) FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'general'

M01-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS plane_count FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.airline_id ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) DESC
M01-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS fleet_size FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.airline_id ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M02-CAS: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft.status = 'active' GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
M02-SCH: SELECT T1.model, COUNT(T2.aircraft_id) FROM aircraft_types AS T1 INNER JOIN aircraft AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T2.status = 'active' GROUP BY T1.model
M02-BIZ: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS active_count FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft.status = 'active' GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
M02-VAG: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS active_planes FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft.status = 'active' GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM airports JOIN flights ON airports.airport_id = flights.origin_airport_id WHERE airports.city = 'Istanbul' AND flights.status = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND airports.icao_code = 'IST'
M03-VAG: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.event_id) AS event_count FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN tracking_events AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T1.iata_code = 'IST' AND T2.event_code IN ('DEP', 'ARR')
M04-CAS: SELECT T1.name AS from, T2.name AS to, COUNT(*) AS count FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id GROUP BY T1.name, T2.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT T1.iata_code, COUNT(T2.flight_id) FROM flights AS T1 INNER JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.origin_airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.origin_airport_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.flight_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND fc.leg_number = 1 GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.destination_airport_id) FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(CAST(T2.delay AS REAL) * 60) FROM flights AS T1 INNER JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.origin_airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.model, AVG((strftime('%s', flights.actual_arrival) - strftime('%s', flights.scheduled_arrival)) / 60) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flights JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, AVG(flights.delay_minutes) FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed'
M06-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights JOIN airlines ON flights.airline_id = airlines.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled'
M06-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY COUNT(flights.flight_id) DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS cancellation_volume FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name
M06-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS cancellation_count FROM flights JOIN airlines ON flights.airline_id = airlines.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name
M07-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, SUM(flights.co2_emissions_kg) / 1000 AS total_co2_tonnes FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.aircraft_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M07-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, ROUND(SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg / 1000), 1) AS avg_co2_emissions_kg FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.aircraft_id JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id JOIN fuel_uplifts ON flights.flight_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M07-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aircraft.airline_id) AS carrier_count, SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) / 1000 AS carbon_footprint_tonnes FROM aircraft JOIN fuel_uplifts ON aircraft.aircraft_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id
M07-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_emissions_kg FROM airlines JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airlines.airline_id = fuel_uplifts.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M08-CAS: SELECT airports.region, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN fuel_uplifts AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id
M08-BIZ: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id
M08-VAG: SELECT airports.country, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.country
M09-CAS: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.airport_id, airports.name HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT airports.iata_code, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.iata_code HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.name HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.airport_id
M10-CAS: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT airports.airport_id) FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1
M10-SCH: SELECT airports.iata_code, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.iata_code HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS bonded_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.name
M10-VAG: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.airport_id
H01-CAS: SELECT a.name, a.tail_number, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft a ON a.airline_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flights f ON f.aircraft_id = a.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, a.tail_number
H01-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY COUNT(flights.flight_id) ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT a.name, a.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft a ON a.airline_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flights f ON f.aircraft_id = a.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, a.model
H01-VAG: SELECT a.name, at.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.airline_id = at.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name, at.model ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT a.name, f.destination_airport_id, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, f.destination_airport_id
H02-SCH: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.destination_airport_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.iata_code ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT a.name, a.icao_code, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM airports a JOIN airlines ai ON a.home_hub_airport_id = ai.airport_id JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND f.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.name, ai.name
H02-VAG: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) as flight_count FROM airports a JOIN airlines ai ON a.airport_id = ai.home_airport_id JOIN flights f ON ai.airline_id = f.airline_id GROUP BY a.name
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date)
H03-SCH: SELECT invoices.issued_date, SUM(invoices.amount_usd), SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY invoices.issued_date) FROM invoices WHERE invoices.issued_date LIKE '2025%'
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(payments.amount_usd) AS paid_amount FROM invoices JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id WHERE invoices.issued_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date)
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(invoices.amount_usd) - SUM(payments.amount_usd) FROM invoices JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', scheduled_departure) AS month, COUNT(flight_id) AS completed_flights, SUM(distance_km) AS total_distance, AVG(distance_km) AS avg_distance FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', scheduled_departure)
H04-SCH: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)
H04-BIZ: SELECT flights.month, SUM(flights.distance_km) AS total_volume_km, (SUM(flights.distance_km) - LAG(SUM(flights.distance_km)) OVER (ORDER BY flights.month)) / LAG(SUM(flights.distance_km)) OVER (ORDER BY flights.month) AS month_over_month_change FROM flights INNER JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flights.scheduled_departure LIKE '%/%/2023' GROUP BY flights.month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure) AS month, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(flights.scheduled_departure - flights.scheduled_arrival) AS avg_ground_time FROM flights INNER JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(julianday(flights.actual_departure) - julianday(flights.actual_arrival)) AS avg_time_diff FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_departure)) AS avg_turnaround FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed'
H06-CAS: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.name, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
H06-SCH: SELECT customers.name, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS percentage FROM customers JOIN shipments ON customers.customer_id = shipments.customer_id JOIN invoices ON shipments.shipment_id = invoices.shipment_id WHERE customers.name IN (SELECT name FROM customers WHERE credit_limit_usd > 4) GROUP BY customers.name
H06-BIZ: SELECT customers.account_code, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS revenue, (SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id WHERE invoices.amount_usd > 0.04 * (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)
H06-VAG: SELECT COUNT(customers.customer_id) AS total_customers, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
H07-CAS: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, SUM(flight_cargo.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_cargo_tonnes FROM airports JOIN flight_cargo ON airports.airport_id = flight_cargo.origin_airport_id GROUP BY airports.airport_id ORDER BY total_cargo_tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT a.name, SUM(fc.total_weight_kg / 1000) AS tonnes FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND fc.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT a.name, SUM(s.total_weight_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM airports a JOIN shipments s ON a.airport_id = s.origin_airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT a.name, COUNT(cd.declaration_id) AS export_count FROM airports a JOIN customs_declarations cd ON a.airport_id = cd.shipment_id WHERE cd.declaration_type = 'export' GROUP BY a.name
H08-CAS: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types JOIN flights ON aircraft_types.type_id = flights.type_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flight_cargo.load_sequence = 1 AND flight_cargo.total_volume_m3 * 0.5 < flight_cargo.volume_m3
H08-SCH: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types JOIN flights ON aircraft_types.type_id = flights.type_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND SUM(flight_cargo.total_volume_m3) > 0.5 * aircraft_types.max_volume_m3 GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
H08-BIZ: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types JOIN flights ON aircraft_types.type_id = flights.type_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flight_cargo.leg_status = 'flown' AND (flight_cargo.total_volume_m3 / aircraft_types.max_volume_m3) > 0.5
H08-VAG: SELECT aircraft_types.model, AVG(CASE WHEN flight_cargo.chargeable_weight_kg / aircraft_types.max_payload_kg >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS fill_ratio FROM aircraft_types JOIN flight_cargo ON aircraft_types.type_id = flight_cargo.type_id GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
H09-CAS: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tail_number) FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN aircraft AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.home_airport_id INNER JOIN flights AS T3 ON T2.aircraft_id = T3.aircraft_id WHERE T1.is_cargo_hub = 1 AND T3.status = 'completed' AND T3.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL
H09-SCH: SELECT COUNT(T1.tail_number) FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id WHERE T1.is_cargo_hub = 1 AND T2.status = 'completed'
H09-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aircraft.tail_number) FROM airports JOIN aircraft ON airports.airport_id = aircraft.home_airport_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND airports.region = 'north_america'
H09-VAG: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flights.origin_airport_id) AS airports_visited FROM flights
H10-CAS: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN (cd.duty_amount_usd + cd.vat_amount_usd) / s.declared_value_usd > 0.2 THEN s.shipment_id END) FROM airports AS a JOIN shipments AS s ON a.airport_id = s.origin_airport_id JOIN customs_declarations AS cd ON s.shipment_id = cd.shipment_id
H10-SCH: SELECT T1.customs_country, COUNT(T1.declaration_id) FROM customs_declarations AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouses AS T2 ON T1.warehouse_id = T2.warehouse_id WHERE T1.declaration_type = 'import' AND T1.duty_amount_usd + T1.vat_amount_usd > 0.2 * T1.customs_value_usd
H10-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE inspection_required = 1 AND inspection_result = 'passed' AND (duty_rate_pct * customs_value_usd) > 20 AND warehouse_id IN (SELECT warehouse_id FROM warehouses WHERE country = 'Market A')
H10-VAG: SELECT AVG(customs_declarations.duty_rate_pct) AS avg_duty_rate FROM airports AS a JOIN shipments AS s ON a.airport_id = s.origin_airport_id JOIN customs_declarations AS cd ON s.shipment_id = cd.shipment_id
